summary: Two candidate defects in the new framing code: a missing bounds check in Decode, and an apparent silent truncation in Encode.

findings.title: Decode panics on a truncated frame
findings.description: Decode reads the length byte and slices b[HeaderSize:HeaderSize+n] without checking that the buffer actually holds n more bytes, so a short or corrupted frame panics with slice bounds out of range.

evidence.excerpt:
n := int(b[0])
return b[HeaderSize : HeaderSize+n], nil

findings.title: Encode silently truncates payloads longer than 255 bytes
findings.description: Encode stores the payload length in a single byte, so any payload of 256 bytes or more has its length wrap, and the frame reports a shorter body than it carries.
